articles.summary: Corning Incorporated (NYSE: GLW) today announced its first-quarter 2026 results and provided its outlook for second-quarter 2026. News Summary: First-quarter core sales grew 18% to $4.35 billion, and core EPS grew 30% to $0.70 versus Q1-2025. Robust demand for Gen AI products and the ramp of new solar products drove Q1 growth. Optical Communications sales grew 36%, and Solar sales were up 80% year over year. Two additional hyperscale customers entered into large, long-term agreements with Cornin

articles.summary: Corning Incorporated’s (NYSE: GLW) Board of Directors today declared a quarterly dividend of $0.28 per share. The dividend will be payable on June 29, 2026, to shareholders of record on May 29, 2026.
